in_sanskrit.name: Vikey
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vikey एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vik', which means 'victory'. The suffix 'key' means 'little' or 'small'. This name is a reminder of the victories that come from within, and the strength and wisdom needed to overcome challenges.
